doom.menu.equipment.hint: At most 100% per mob and slot. The remainder keeps normal equipment.
doom.menu.equipment.inactive_hint: INACTIVE: Turn “Extra equipment” ON at the top.

doom.menu.equipment.slot.head: Head
doom.menu.equipment.help.title: EQUIPMENT CHANCES EXPLAINED
doom.menu.equipment.help.card1.title: Example calculation
doom.menu.equipment.help.card1.line1: Zombie/main hand: diamond sword 10%, iron sword 25%.
doom.menu.equipment.help.card1.line2: Result: 10% diamond, 25% iron and 65% normal equipment.
doom.menu.equipment.help.card2.title: One shared pool
doom.menu.equipment.help.card2.line1: Rules for the same mob and slot are added together in list order.
doom.menu.equipment.help.card2.line2: Their combined chance may not exceed 100%.
doom.menu.equipment.help.card3.title: Separate rolls
doom.menu.equipment.help.card3.line1: Every mob and every slot has its own pool and independent random roll.
doom.menu.equipment.help.card3.line2: Head chances therefore do not change the main-hand chance.
doom.menu.equipment.help.card4.title: Normal or extra equipment
doom.menu.equipment.help.card4.line1: OFF or no match: normal Vanilla/mod equipment is preserved.
doom.menu.equipment.help.card4.line2: Match: only that slot is replaced; the mob-loot setting still applies.
doom.menu.equipment.help.card5.title: Which mobs are allowed?
doom.menu.equipment.help.card5.line1: The mob picker only shows eligible mobs from configured waves, the boss and its guards.
doom.menu.equipment.help.card5.line2: The item list matches the mob: zombies get melee weapons, skeletons bows and pillagers crossbows.

doom.menu.automatic.rule.title: Automatic Gateway
doom.menu.automatic.rule.dimensions_hint: Click to select or deselect dimensions. Type to search.
doom.menu.automatic.rule.dimensions.one_: At least one dimension must remain selected.
doom.menu.automatic.rule.exploration_dis: Required exploration distance in new chunks (blocks)
doom.menu.automatic.rule.exploration_hin: Rerolled between min. and max. after every event; minimum 32. Teleports do not count.
doom.menu.automatic.rule.interval_hint: Timer mode chooses a new random delay after every event
doom.menu.help.automation.trigger: Trigger chooses between exploration progress and a random timer.
doom.menu.help.automation.scope: Event scope chooses independent player events or one shared server event.
doom.menu.help.automation.player: Per player: progress and online timer belong to each player individually.
doom.menu.help.automation.server: Server event: one shared trigger chooses a random eligible player.
doom.menu.help.automation.limits: Players already at their owner limit are excluded before target selection.
doom.menu.help.exploration.personal: Only movement through chunks new to that player's recent history counts.
doom.menu.help.exploration.persist: Progress survives logout and restart; teleports and Spectator never count. Creative counts only when enabled under Automation.
doom.menu.help.timer: Personal timers count online time only; server timers are shared by the whole rule.
doom.menu.help.command.basic: Copy: open a safe Easy gateway at the command source
doom.menu.help.command.quest: Copy: exact ownerless quest gateway that bypasses dimension capacity
doom.menu.help.command.force: Force is OP-only. A player owner limit remains mandatory; command blocks have no owner.
doom.menu.help.api.owner: owner(UUID) makes the gateway count toward that player's configured allowance.
doom.menu.help.api.ownerless: Omit owner for quest/structure events; sourceId can identify the quest.
doom.menu.help.api.events: OPENED and LIFECYCLE report creation, completion, failure and final closing.
doom.menu.help.api.thread: Call the server-only API on the Minecraft server thread and store gateway UUIDs.
doom.menu.help.card.start.title: How do I enable automatic gateways?
doom.menu.help.card.start.line1: Open Automation, turn Automatic gateways ON and create or edit a rule.
doom.menu.help.card.start.line2: Rule enabled must also be ON. OFF pauses that rule without deleting its settings.
doom.menu.help.card.exploration.title: What exactly counts as exploration?
doom.menu.help.card.exploration.line1: A player gains distance only inside chunks new to that player's stored recent history.
doom.menu.help.card.exploration.line2: Pregenerated chunks count; teleports and Spectator never do. Creative counts only with its Automation option enabled.
doom.menu.help.card.timer.title: How does the random timer work?
doom.menu.help.card.timer.line1: A 20-30 minute range is rerolled after opening: for example 21, then 28, then 30 minutes.
doom.menu.help.card.timer.line2: Per-player timers count online time only; a server event uses one shared timer.
doom.menu.help.card.scope.title: What is the difference between Per player and Server event?
doom.menu.help.card.scope.line1: Per player gives everyone separate progress or a timer and targets that exact player.
doom.menu.help.card.scope.line2: Server event has one shared trigger and randomly selects one eligible player.
doom.menu.help.card.limits.title: Which portal limit wins?
doom.menu.help.card.limits.line1: Gateways per player is shared by Eyes, automation, player commands and API owner(UUID).
doom.menu.help.card.limits.line2: Max active is an extra rule limit; the hard capacity of four per dimension also applies.
doom.menu.help.card.equipment.title: How does extra mob equipment work?
doom.menu.help.card.equipment.line1: Open Equipment in an eye profile and choose the mob, item, slot and percentage chance.
doom.menu.help.card.equipment.line2: OFF leaves normal Vanilla/mod equipment untouched; mobs that miss the roll keep it as well.
doom.menu.help.card.equipment.chances.ti: How are multiple percentage rules distributed?
doom.menu.help.card.equipment.chances.li: 10% diamond sword + 25% iron sword in the same slot make a combined 35%.
The other 65% keeps the normal weapon; other mobs and slots roll separately.
doom.menu.help.card.equipment.eligible.t: Why are some mobs missing from the equipment list?
doom.menu.help.card.equipment.eligible.l: Hand slots allow visible weapon users; armour slots only allow mobs that visibly render worn armour.
Mod mobs opt in separately through hand or armour entity-type tags; spiders remain blocked.
doom.menu.help.card.wards.title: How do Hell Wards protect an area?
doom.menu.help.card.wards.line1: The craftable 1x1 to 5x5 ward blocks gateways; right-click it to display its protected chunks.
doom.menu.help.card.wards.line2: Only its owner or operators can mine it; it expires automatically after 30 days without a login.
doom.menu.help.card.persistence.title: What happens after logout or a server restart?
doom.menu.help.card.persistence.line1: Exploration, recent chunks and personal timers are saved and restored.
doom.menu.help.card.persistence.line2: Relogging never resets chunks or progress; a personal timer pauses while offline.
doom.menu.help.card.command.normal.title: Command block: open a normal gateway
doom.menu.help.card.command.normal.line1: doom gateway open easy searches for safe ground near the command block.
doom.menu.help.card.command.normal.line2: The command block has no owner and the normal four-per-dimension capacity applies.
doom.menu.help.card.command.quest.title: Command block: open a required quest gateway
doom.menu.help.card.command.quest.line1: doom gateway open quest_profile 100 70 -250 exact force uses that exact position.
doom.menu.help.card.command.quest.line2: Force is OP-only and bypasses dimension capacity, but never a player's owner limit.
doom.menu.help.card.api.player.title: API: create an encounter owned by a player
doom.menu.help.card.api.player.line1: Use owner(player UUID); the encounter then consumes that player's configured allowance.
doom.menu.help.card.api.player.line2: If the owner is already at the limit, open returns PORTAL_LIMIT_REACHED.
doom.menu.help.card.api.quest.title: API: create a quest or structure encounter
doom.menu.help.card.api.quest.line1: Omit owner so no player allowance is consumed; use sourceId to identify the quest.
doom.menu.help.card.api.quest.line2: For a mandatory controlled arena, respectPortalLimits(false) bypasses dimension capacity.
doom.menu.help.card.api.events.title: API: how does my mod learn the result?
doom.menu.help.card.api.events.line1: OPENED reports creation; LIFECYCLE reports COMPLETED, FAILED and final CLOSED.
doom.menu.help.card.api.events.line2: Store UUID/sourceId; use openAsync off-thread and handle the typed failure codes.
doom.menu.automatic.rule.help.enabled: Pauses this rule without deleting its settings or saved progress.
doom.menu.automatic.rule.help.trigger.ex: Requires the configured personal new-chunk exploration distance.
doom.menu.automatic.rule.help.trigger.ti: Chooses a new random delay between minimum and maximum minutes.
doom.menu.automatic.rule.help.scope.play: Every player has independent progress or an independent online timer.
doom.menu.automatic.rule.help.scope.serv: One shared rule trigger selects a random eligible player.
doom.menu.automatic.rule.help.max_active: Additional active limit for this rule; global owner and dimension limits still apply.
